title: Old Fashioned
summary: A timeless whiskey cocktail built around balance, bitters, and a proper pour.
ingredients: 1/4 oz simple syrup or 1 sugar cube
steps: Add sugar or simple syrup and bitters to a mixing glass.
Strain over a large ice cube.
Express orange peel over the drink and garnish.
notes: Use rye for a spicier profile or bourbon for a rounder, sweeter drink.
